h: An Enduring Oath Requires Fear Service and Attachment to Hashem

p: In Midrash Rabbah at the beginning of this parsha
'And you shall swear, As Hashem lives, in truth,
in justice and in righteousness, etc.'
you are not permitted to swear by My Name
אֶת ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא (דְּבָרִים ו, יג)
and what is lacking in the pasuk alone,
where he fears for the moment
Perhaps he will go bad afterward.
that is, with them it is already truly so,
for they were already called so.
And this was written at the tenth trial,
that it became fixed in him at the root,
for this is what the number ten indicates.
And here it put Iyov before Yosef;
for although according to most opinions
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (בְּרֵאשִׁית כה, כז)
although it was before the tenth trial
that is, already then there began
when he was refined in the attribute of fear
And of Iyov it is written "perfect,"
when the heart is made upright,
that it be a single heart
'and joy for the upright of heart'" (Tehillim 97:11).
that is, the fear became fixed in him,
and he was also born so from the outset,
similar to what is said of Yaakov Avinu:
Which is not so of Yosef:
"And she grabbed him by his garment";
and we said that this indicates
"a language I did not know I heard."
"He made it a testimony in Yehosef" (Tehillim 81:6):
he bound himself to the Shechinah
this Hei that was added to him.
when he became ruler in Mitzrayim,
that he had become a chariot for the attribute of Tzaddik,
that is, he merited through teshuvah,
the aspect of the upper Hei,
that the fear be fixed in him
and because of this he is listed last.
And this is "You shall fear Hashem your God,"
and it corresponds to what is said:
"And you shall swear, As Hashem lives, in truth";
and this is what is said:

p: if you free yourself for Torah
and for occupying yourself with mitzvos,
and you have no other occupation."
that is, that his heart be free
of the affairs of this world,
and then he will merit Torah
which Hashem Yisbarach will bestow on him
And regarding mitzvos it used the term "occupation":
for this is from the side of man.
And this corresponds to what is said
justice, the aspect of the Holy One, blessed be He,
And this corresponds to Torah and mitzvah,
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קכג, רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב)
and this corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak and Avraham:
the attribute of "the Fear of Yitzchak"
זֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אֶת ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא
this is what is said: "You shall fear Hashem your God,"
corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
freeing himself for words of Torah
וְזֶהוּ כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"But you who cleave to Hashem your God."
and this is that he cast filth into her
Has it not already been said (Devarim 4:24):
'For Hashem your God is a consuming fire'?"
which are the aspect of the Holy One, blessed be He
are a fire that consumes fire.
even to one who does not cleave
"Whoever marries his daughter to Torah study,
to one who reads and learns, etc.";
And this is what it says:
אִם יֵשׁ בְּךָ כָּל הַמִּדּוֹת הָאֵלּוּ
and this is what is said:
"and by His Name shall you swear (tishave'a),"
And corresponding to this it says in Yirmiyahu (4:2):
"and nations shall bless themselves by Him";
to fulfill "and to Him shall you cleave,"
from the term "one who layers and grafts."
And this is as in the future,
that those who remain of them
and will be grafted onto Yisrael.
And so at the trial of the Akeidah it was promised (Bereishis 22:18):
"And by your seed shall be blessed
all the nations of the earth."
this was promised for the future (Bereishis 12:3):
"And through you shall be blessed, etc."
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (יִרְמְיָהוּ ט, כג)
along the lines of what is said (Yirmiyahu 9:23):
"But let him who glories glory in this:
וְהוּא מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and it is the attribute of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
of whom it is written, "You will give truth to Yaakov"
the letter Vav, which is called the letter of truth;
and it is the attribute of Daas,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב יד, ב)
"to Yaakov, in the secret of Daas."
And the three good gifts that it lists
הֵם גַּם כֵּן כְּנֶגֶד הַג׳ אָבוֹת
also correspond to the three Avos
מִכֹּחַ גְּבוּרָתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
through the power of the might of the Holy One, blessed be He.
